text:
maya: Hey team — recording window for MerchantX testimonial. We want a 20–30s quote + a 15m interview clip to tie into the May webinar promo. Target publish: May 12. Are these dates workable?

sam: Thumbs-up on timing. Free Tue/Wed mornings. Do we need legal signoff before recording?

lina: Yes — we need signed consent + quote approval. Please drop the proposed quote and the release in this thread. I can review redlines by EOD tomorrow.

kevin: For inbound leads, route webinar signups from this asset to the SDR queue "Mid-Market Merchants". I'll sync with Ops on ownership. @maya can you add UTM tracking to the landing page?

maya: Draft quote below:
"MerchantX reduced inference costs by 3x after switching to Redwood, which let us launch faster and cut infra spend."

sam: Nice. For social copy suggest shortening: "3x lower inference costs + faster launch."

lina: Legal note: avoid exact % claims unless Research can back it. Can we link the benchmark? Need Research sign-off.

maya: Ok — I can swap "3x" for "significantly lower" unless Research confirms. @noah can you validate the benchmark numbers?

publish-bot: Automated checklist created: asset-intake-5678. Next steps: recording slot, signed release, quote approval, asset tagging, UTM assignment.

noah: Confirmed — benchmark shows ~2.8x median cost reduction on the Merchant workload. Fine to say "~3x" if we attach the benchmark doc and dataset. I'll upload the CSV to Drive and post link here.

lina: If Research uploads the backing doc, legal will allow "~3x" but we need the parenthetical link on the landing page and a short methodology blurb. I'll prep the release template and redline the quote if needed.

kevin: Routing checklist: ensure marketing forms push to SFDC campaign "Merchant Webinar May" and SDR owners assigned automatically. I'll post the flowchart to #eng-ops and tag Ops.

maya: Scheduling proposal: Wed 5/5 10:30am PT for a 20m recording. @kevin @lina any conflicts?

sam: Good for me.

kevin: Works.

lina: Works if release + quote draft are in by EOD Mon.

maya: Perfect — I'll lock the calendar, share the pre-interview script, release form, and a short prep packet. Will add UTM and the SFDC campaign tag. Thanks! :tada:
